name: Terror Shrike

offensiveAbilities.name: Sprint
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per minute

Effect The terror shrike Strides three times in a straight line.

offensiveAbilities.name: Stunning Screech
offensiveAbilities.description:
The terror shrike unleashes a haunting screech that causes prey to freeze in fear. Each creature in a 30 foot emanation other than terror birds must attempt a DC 19 Will save. Regardless of the result, creatures are then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Off-Guard until the start of its turn.

Failure The creature is Stunned 1.

Critical Failure The creature is Stunned 2.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sudden Charge
offensiveAbilities.description: The terror shrike Strides twice. If it ends its movement within melee reach of one creature, it can make a melee Strike against that creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tearing Clutch
offensiveAbilities.description: The terror bird's powerful beak can tear through flesh. On a successful beak Strike, the target takes 1 bleed damage. This bleed damage increases to 1d8 bleed on a critical hit.

description:
The terror shrike, also known as the scythe beak, is a more powerful species of terror bird. Large terror bird flocks typically have one or two terror shrikes as leaders.

Terror birds aren't one species but rather a family of deadly, flightless avian predators. All terror birds are capable of bursts of great speed and have powerful beaks that can tear apart the flesh of their prey. Most stalk large, open prairies and steppes, competing directly with other sizable predators such as large cats and wolves.
